title: Per Diem Accrual in the Trade-In Roll-In Payoff Figure
content:
The roll-in payoff figure is the payoff side of the negative equity a **Trade-In Agreements** roll-in into Kestrel Auto Finance is figured on. It depends on how far the latest recorded payoff quote's good-through date lies behind the day of recording, counted in calendar days.

## Rule

| Latest quote's good-through date, compared with the day of recording | Roll-in payoff figure |
|---|---|
| Passed by at least 1 and no more than 7 days | The quote amount plus the quote's per diem for each calendar day after the good-through date through the day of recording |
| Passed by more than 7 days | The quote amount plus the per diem for 7 days only |
| Not passed (the day of recording is on or before the good-through date) | The quote amount alone |

The quote amount, the good-through date and the per diem are those of the latest recorded payoff quote entry on the agreement.

## Boundaries (hypothetical quote: amount $18000.00, per diem $3.20, good through the 10th)

| Day of recording | Days past the good-through date | Roll-in payoff figure |
|---|---|---|
| The 10th | 0 | $18000.00 |
| The 11th | 1 | $18003.20 |
| The 17th | 7 | $18022.40 |
| The 20th | 10 | $18022.40 (accrual held at 7 days) |
